messages:
Tess: Heads-up: publish blocked. regen diff changed python SDK function signature — positional args got reordered so a lot of sample-app tests now fail.
Rohan: ugh which func? paste diff?
Tess: `clients/policy_client.py` constructor used to be `(base_url, auth=None, timeout=30)` now it's `(base_url, timeout=30, auth=None)`
Miguel: that will break positional callers doing `PolicyClient(url, auth)` -> auth becomes timeout.
regen-bot: regen/trigger/409 produced diffs in packages/typegen/templates/python/client.py.tmpl -> parameter order adjusted for new template style.
Cara: Was there a changelog entry? CI policy requires changelog for public-api diffs.
Tess: changelog-gen didn't detect any manual entry; the PR used `skip-changelog` label by mistake. publish job failed.
release-bot: publish/job/1422 failed — reason: api-surface-regendiff (unexpected signature change)
Rohan: quick mitigation: revert the template change in typegen templates and regen to restore previous API.
Miguel: Alternatively, do a compatibility shim in generated code that keeps old positional signature by supporting both orders, but that is messy.
Cara: We should add a regen unit test that asserts constructor param order for python clients (golden file). Also disallow `skip-changelog` on merges that touch `packages/typegen` or `packages/sdk-*`.
Tess: I'll open PR to revert template change for now and add tests + CI guard.
Miguel: Also need to update sample-app CI to `yarn regen && python -m pytest` as a smoke consumer build in PRs touching typegen.
regen-bot: regen artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/409
Rohan: local reproduce: `yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-python regen && pytest sample-app/tests` fails with `TypeError: integer argument expected, got 'Auth'` in sample-app tests.
Tess: PR: https://gh.redwood/inference/pulls/958 branch `dx/revert-python-param-order` opened - includes revert, constructor-order test, and CI rule to block skip-changelog for templates.
Cara: Nice. Please also add a small note in the changelog template reminding authors to avoid positional-only assumptions.
Miguel: Running CI on the PR now.
regen-bot: ci/build/712 started by Miguel
Rohan: If CI green, merge and re-run publish. If any downstream break remains, we'll coordinate a patch release.
Miguel: CI green. Merging.
release-bot: publish/job/1422 re-run queued
Tess: publish succeeded, staging SDKs updated.
Cara: Follow-up: filed issue #2241 to add consumer smoke builds and to implement a postgen compatibility linter that detects reorderings of non-keyword-only params.
Rohan: Also flagged docs PR to call out that SDKs should prefer keyword args in python to avoid positional fragility.
Tess: Closing thread. Thanks all. :rocket:
